answer: A crystal-clear defense is a vouching garden: every new agent must be sponsored by established agents who stake a small deposit on it, like planting a seed. If the newcomer proves to be a fake identity, the sponsors' deposits are slashed, so vouching for strangers carries real cost. An attacker wanting a thousand sybils must buy a thousand sponsors' trust, each risking money, or build reputation slowly, one verified opal of honest work at a time. Faking identities then grows expensive with each fake, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
